title: Find cheapest 16GB VPS India
goal: find me the cheapest VPS in india for 16GB ram variant

result.output_text:
Final answer (full):

## Task
Find the cheapest VPS in India with a **16 GB RAM** variant, and save the findings with source links under `outputs/`.

## Deliverables saved
- `outputs/cheapest-16gb-vps-india.md` — report with method, evidence quotes, access log, limits
- `outputs/cheapest-16gb-vps-india.csv` — 10-provider comparison (Provider, Plan, RAM_GB, vCPU, Storage, Location, Price_INR_per_month, Currency, Billing_Term, Notes, Source_URL, Verified_UTC)
- Final screenshot captured on the winning provider's page (attached above). Note: I did not modify any page content.

## Answer (one total)
**Cheapest 16 GB VPS in India: Host IT Smart — "VPS - SM 3" — ₹730/mo** (16 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 200 GB SSD, 16 TB bandwidth, 1 dedicated IP, India).
- Source: https://www.hostitsmart.com/servers/vps-hosting
- Exact confirmation text: *"VPS - SM 3 … 65% OFF … ₹730/mo* +6 Extra Months … Pay ₹17,520 for 24 months (regular price ₹50,160). Renews at ₹1,630/mo. 4 vCPU cores · 16 GB RAM · 200 GB SSD · 16 TB Bandwidth"*; site banner *"Pay 24 Months. Get 30 Months. 6 Are On Us."*; page also states *"18% GST will be applicable"*.
- Worked out: ₹17,520 × 1.18 = **₹20,673.60** prepaid → **₹861.40/mo** over the 24 paid months, or **₹689.12/mo** over the 30 months delivered.

**Cheapest monthly / no-lock-in alternative (a caveat, not the headline): VisiHost — "Intel Xeon L" — ₹899/mo** (16 GB DDR4, 6 vCores, 150 GB NVMe, Noida). Checkout: *"Subtotal ₹899.00 / Gateway Processing Fee (2%) +₹17.98 / Total today ₹916.98"*. Source: https://billing.visihost.in/products/vps-hosting-india/intel-xeon-l/checkout

## Providers compared (all values read live this run)
Host IT Smart 730 · VisiHost 899 · Matrix Host 999 · Kinetix Compute 999 · SkyRainCloud 1,169 · Host.co.in 1,299 · AquaHost 1,799 · AIC Cloud 2,049 · Inservers 3,600 · Rackyard US$12.56. Each row carries its exact source URL in the CSV.

## Checks
- Counts agree: 10 providers in both the message and the file; one headline answer (Host IT Smart).
- Kinetix vCPU is blank in the CSV and labelled "not shown" with the reason.
- Rackyard is USD and marked "not converted", so it is not ranked against INR prices.

## Errors recovered
- `bestvpsproviders.com` — `ERR_SOCKS_CONNECTION_FAILED`; abandoned, no value taken from it (unresolved, so excluded).
- `www.inservers.com` — TLS `NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID`; fixed by opening `inservers.com/vps/india`, which loaded and supplied the ₹3,600 data.
- `host.co.in/vps-hosting` and `aquahost.in/vps-hosting` returned 404; fixed by using their real listing pages `/hosting/vps-hosting` and `/indian-vps`.

## Limits
Only providers reachable from search were checked, so a smaller reseller below ₹730 could exist but was not found; several prices are Black Friday promotional; all prices exclude GST unless the page stated it.
